mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_file (file_no, board_no, file_url, file_name, file_size, file_type, created_at, delete_yn) VALUES (board_file_seq.nextval, #{boardNo}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT file_no AS fileNo, board_no AS boardNo, file_url AS fileUrl, file_name AS fileName, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, created_at AS createdAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM board_file WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at ASC
